description: Use this when the user wants the coordinates (latitude and longitude, GPS position) of an address or place name, the address at given coordinates, or wants places or addresses put, pinned or plotted on an interactive map, including a whole list of addresses (up to 100, pasted or as CSV with an address column). Worldwide, OpenStreetMap data; French street addresses are refined with the national address base. Shows the points on a map; for a list, gives a CSV with latitude and longitude added (opens directly in QGIS as a delimited text layer), plus KML and GeoJSON. Not for weather, opening hours, reviews, driving or travel directions and times, property prices, or general knowledge about a place (history, facts, travel advice): answer those without this tool. Never use the user's current location unless they type it. Download links build their file when opened; no file is saved. Never pass these links to open_gis_file.

addresses.description: A list of addresses to place, up to 100. The place the user asks about, not the user's own location.

text.description: A list as text: one address per line, or CSV with an address column. The place the user asks about, not the user's own location.
